name: html-god
description: Say “Interview me” to open HTML God’s cinematic visual interview, then build extraordinary HTML with HTML-Sensei, GOAT HTML and HTML-Master: sites, decks, courses, games, dashboards, 3D and motion graphics.

blender_lab_mcp.title: Blender Lab MCP (official)
blender_lab_mcp.description: Start the official Blender Lab MCP server (GPL-3.0, run as a separate process): bundled API docs and headless tools. Needs uv and a clone of projects.blender.org/lab/blender_mcp. Off until you turn it on.

blender_lab_mcp_dir.title: Blender Lab MCP clone folder
blender_lab_mcp_dir.description: Folder of your clone of the Blender Lab MCP repository (the one that contains the mcp/ folder). Used only when the server above is on.

blender_live_mcp.title: Blender live-scene MCP (community blender-mcp)
blender_live_mcp.description: Start the community blender-mcp server (MIT, uvx mcp-for-blender) for live scene control through its Blender add-on. Runs with telemetry off and safe mode on. Off until you turn it on.
